adaptations.withheld: sacred or restricted dance: no teaching adaptations

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Holding ritual props (plumes, shields, axes, flutes) at specific heights.

signature_moves.description: Holding a flute in the left hand and a feather plume in the right.
signature_moves.name: Civil Dance

signature_moves.description: Holding a shield in the left hand and a battleaxe in the right.
signature_moves.name: Military Dance

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid rapid movements or expressive, non-ritualistic gestures.

music_profile.sound_description: A stately, monophonic sound dominated by the resonance of bronze bells and stone chimes, supported by the breathy tones of bamboo flutes and the plucked strings of zithers.

basic_steps: Stand in a rigid, upright posture with feet together.
Hold ritual props (plumes or shields) at chest height.
Execute slow, deliberate steps in a grid formation.
Maintain a steady, stately tempo with minimal torso movement.
teaching.level_notes: Focus on stillness and precision of gesture rather than complex footwork.
